method: Prompt changed only to add the alt_text instruction (inserted between the caption and photo_category instructions) — the caption instruction itself and players[]/quality/visible_text instructions are byte-for-byte unchanged from the prior ADR 0006 receipt. Ran the real, updated prompt through the live gemini-2.5-flash-lite model on 10 real DWdCET (Milliken at North Central) photos already live in production (43 rows, confirmed via a read-only row count) — no database write. Read each of the 10 source images directly, at full resolution (not the read-guard's downscaled copy, which a first pass mistakenly relied on for two photos and produced two false observations, both retracted here), and checked each caption against it. 10/10 passed inspectCaption (0 issues). 8 of 10 named at least one jersey number. One defect confirmed at full resolution and left recorded, a pre-existing vision-model limitation independent of this change: DSC09432, 09435, and 09437 mislabel the action verb (serve vs. set vs. spike) despite correctly reading colors, numbers, and scene. DSC09426's jersey number was RE-CHECKED at full resolution after a first-pass note (made from a 1000px downscaled copy) claimed the caption misread #11 as #17 — the full-resolution frame shows the jersey clearly reads 17; the caption was correct and the earlier note was my own misreading of the downscaled copy, retracted. DSC09440's caption names 'number 10' for the front light-blue player; at full resolution that player's number is genuinely occluded by her own raised/pointing hand and could not be confirmed as correct or wrong at any resolution examined — left as unconfirmed, not asserted as an error. That caption's other claim, 'a player in red jumps', does not match the frame (the red player is in a low defensive crouch), which stands as a separate, minor scene-description inaccuracy.
scope: 10 DWdCET/Milliken photos (already in production, 43 rows), real model, no DB write
